# codegen_wasm tests that fail at a90285c2 (generics-gpu d6414d14 merged into
# p9b-parser-perf), measured 2026-10-18 on the laptop RTX 3070: 44 of 115.
# They fail identically before and after the zero-initialized `let x: T;`
# change. 40 of them build their source inline, and their CLI builds give
# the same exit and the same bytes on both builds. Gates should check for
# "no failure outside this list" instead of rereading the whole suite.
#
# One test per line: name, failure today, detail.
# - LNC0057: the GPU lowering status rejects the module (flags=0x10 is an
#   unsupported Wasm target row, 0x400 an optimization-structure failure).
#   Wasm reports these as "compiler execution failed" instead of an
#   LNC0017-style source-spanned diagnostic.
# - LNC0006: the type checker rejects the source (std host-import wrappers).
# - runtime: the module compiles, but node exits nonzero or the returned
#   value is wrong.
# Wasm is secondary to x86. These stay as known gaps unless a generics bug
# also shows up on x86. Payload enums and the Wasm diagnostics are tracked
# as matrix probe p54.
